theorems.name: Submission.sff_fderivWithin_chart_direction
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (f g : Rn N → (Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N)) (x₀ : Rn n), V ∈ 𝓝 x₀ → ψ '' V ⊆ M → DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x₀ → DifferentiableAt ℝ g (ψ x₀) → f =ᶠ[𝓝[M] ψ x₀] g → ∀ a : Rn n, fderivWithin ℝ f M (ψ x₀) (fderiv ℝ ψ x₀ a) = fderiv ℝ g (ψ x₀) (fderiv ℝ ψ x₀ a)
